measurement_policy: CoreText Helvetica 16pt; every role uses typographic width and ascent+descent height
measurement_limit: One pass; status 5 and next_request_count expose cases needing additional measurements
geometry: Unconstrained core coordinates; bounds are left,top,right,bottom, not width,height. The application may scale to fit.
path_encoding: [kind,x,y,c1x,c1y,c2x,c2y]; kind 0 move,1 line,2 cubic,3 close; cubic endpoint is x,y

paint_slots.1: role fill channel for fill, role stroke channel for stroke

text_ref: Index into measurements; text rectangles use top-left coordinates
